_provenance.note: Derived 2026-08-27 from geospatialhosting.com (app 1.1.11-b47ea) by reading the logo SVG's fill attributes and the bundle's own global CSS. This file is the ONLY place brand values live — correcting it re-themes everything.

confirmed.accent: logo bottom layer, and the ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb rule
confirmed.secondary: logo middle layer (the bundle rounds it to #53A0C8 for the loading spinner)
confirmed.font.family: the bundle's body rule sets 'Lato', sans-serif

assumed.surface: not readable from the bundle (Chakra supplies it at runtime); borrowed from the Kartoza pack, whose palette this brand shares

rejected.Avenir: the site self-hosts Avenir TTFs, but Avenir is a commercial Linotype face and must not be redistributed inside a container image. Lato is SIL OFL, is what the site actually sets on body, and is already in this flake.
rejected.Sen: loaded by the site from Google Fonts but never observed being applied, and the egress lockdown means a runtime Google Fonts fetch would be blocked anyway.
rejected.#E53E3E: Chakra UI's stock red.500 rather than a brand decision.
